medium.name: vivid retro pop-art with mythic physical print character
construction: broad material masses and legible room/object silhouettes before local detail
opaque gouache-like color with dry mineral scumble
selective ink, hatching, stipple, coarse print grain, and mild registration drift
hand-cut edges and fitted physical joins
coherent shared contact and cast shadows under the scene's declared lighting; warm northwest light is an anchor-specific choice
medium.code_boundary: Authored raster, drawn/inked assets, and capable native 3D construction may serve the medium with exact source admission and lineage. Intentional illustrative outlines are allowed. Crude primitive substitutes, repeated monoline seams, random scratches, and noise passed off as authored material finish are not. A software switch is not evidence of improved quality.

default_roles.light_mass: warm limestone, bone, or scene-native pale material
default_roles.field: scene-native earth or floor hue kept quieter than the primary mass
default_roles.cool_structure: restrained turquoise, lapis, verdigris, or setting-equivalent cool mineral
default_roles.warm_accent: ochre, saffron, madder, rust, or setting-equivalent warm accent
default_roles.metal: aged brass or setting-native oxidized metal
default_roles.fracture: charcoal, deep plum, or another low-chroma structural dark

palette.rule: Palette describes scene-native material roles, never flat color bands or color-only elevation. Select anchors by feature, setting, medium, and practical viewing scale; do not blend every anchor palette or impose Cultist's Lair green/gold. Prior acceptance is not a ceiling for a newly named quality target.

hierarchy.primary: one governing place or spatial composition within a connected map; a dominant object is optional
hierarchy.supporting: scene-appropriate rooms and activity clusters whose furniture, work, storage, access, and outputs make use recognizable while preserving circulation
hierarchy.tertiary: recognizable objects and selective accents; keyed interactables match the manuscript, incidental dressing need not create a keyed interaction
hierarchy.quiet: intentional low-contrast playable space with enough material identity for the scene; purposeful empty or monumental rooms remain valid without a prop or event quota
tests: layout, rooms/activity clusters, objects, then accents read at their relevant scales
detail and sharpness are distributed unequally
room detail preserves connected routes, sightlines, thresholds, and complete-map composition

quiet_space_rules: use selective wear, repair, or edge-born detail where it supports the place; do not require an invented cause for every mark
concentrate contrast around useful reading and activity; quiet space is not generic blankness and richness is not uniform distress
do not fill quiet space with ornament, glyphs, or repeated texture cadence
prohibited_tells: rigid or faceted primitive finish that contradicts the declared material and medium
automatic vines, roots, veins, wire, lightning, or all-over cracks
pseudo-writing, improvised heraldry, barcode cadence, or UI-like marks
repeated monoline seams, primitive substitute masonry, random scratches, or noise-authored finish; not intentional illustrative outlines
isolated room plates used as scene cards without coherent whole-map routes, construction, and inhabited relationships
floating props, decal halos, inconsistent projection, stretched rasters, or repeated defects
equal-detail collage, uniform distress, isolated intricate objects without room-level use, or detail soup
rejected, contaminated, or inspection-only candidate/benchmark pixels entering production lineage

scale_gates.thumbnail: primary system, starts/exits, and elevation order read immediately
scale_gates.mid: at practical VTT scale, room/activity groups and object functions read without labels; boundaries, openings, obstructions, and elevation separate through silhouette/material/value rather than darkness, glow, or texture alone
scale_gates.native: joins, edges, shadows, projection, authored texture, and repeated defects pass full-resolution inspection

severity_calibration.hard_blockers: Spatial misinformation, corrupt lineage, wrong-candidate identity, and owner-rejected global medium/composition failures remain non-compensating.
severity_calibration.soft_advisory: A small plausible age, settlement, or handmade irregularity with preserved spatial meaning can be recorded as advisory through ordinary craft judgment; an existing exact Ben disposition remains controlling and cannot be reinterpreted.
severity_calibration.road_cycle_04_boundary: The Road composite remains rejected/unreleased lineage; these source materials are quality references, not permission to reuse the rejected composite or its oblique arches. Component PASSes, valid hashes, and a usable-tonight disposition never establish owner professional-quality acceptance.
